task_completion.description: Creation of partition walls to separate functional zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: New interior wall segments visible in the 2D plan or 3D view that divide the open residential shell into distinct rooms or areas.

task_completion.description: Placement of at least 30 beds or cots in organized rows.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A large area filled with at least 30 bed/cot icons in the 2D plan or 3D models arranged in neat, linear rows.

task_completion.description: Furnishing the Medical Triage area with 3 medical beds and 3 storage cabinets.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A designated area containing exactly or at least 3 bed-type objects and 3 cabinet/wardrobe objects from the catalog.

task_completion.description: Furnishing the Food Service area with 4 large tables and 16 chairs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dining-style area showing at least 4 table objects and a cluster of at least 16 chair objects.

task_completion.description: Furnishing the Registration/Admin area with 3 desks and 6 chairs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An office-style area showing at least 3 desk objects and 6 chair objects.

task_completion.description: Drawing at least 3 dimension lines between rows or paths.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least 3 numerical dimension strings with extension lines (e.g., '150 cm') placed in the 2D plan view to indicate spacing.

task_completion.description: Identification of zones with at least 4 text labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least 4 distinct text annotations (e.g., 'Medical', 'Sleeping', 'Admin', 'Food') visible on the 2D floor plan.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D drawing canvas, and the 'Create walls' or 'Create dimensions' tools.

integrity.description: The agent saved the project using the software's menu.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'File' menu being clicked and the 'Save' or 'Save As' dialog appearing, or the status bar indicating a save operation.

integrity.description: The agent used standard assets from the built-in library.
integrity.visual_evidence: The furniture list in the project matches the names and icons found in the Sweet Home 3D default furniture categories (e.g., Bedroom, Living Room).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a minimum of 30 beds, 3 medical beds, 3 medical cabinets, 4 large tables, 16 dining chairs, 3 desks, and 6 admin chairs. The agent must also draw 3 dimension lines and 4 text labels. The starting file is 'disaster_relief_starter.sh3d'. Success is defined as meeting all quantity counts and layout requirements within the Sweet Home 3D interface.
